title: Case 036: Shower Tap Repair
initial_request: shower pull knob is broken. every time i need to use the shower the cap comes off. i have a video but there’s no way to attach here.
overview: Tenant Noah Bennett reported that the shower pull knob was broken and its cap came off whenever the shower was used. Northbridge Lettings obtained landlord approval, assigned Keystone Services, and arranged visits. The provider reported that a previously fitted tap was faulty, ordered a replacement part, and later confirmed the new bath tap had been fitted. The landlord had raised concerns about delays and missing photos; the referenced photos were not available in the case attachments.
outcome: The provider confirmed the replacement bath tap was fitted at no charge because the previously fitted tap was faulty. The request was marked complete without payment.
